vulnerability.name: USN-8469-1
vulnerability.description: Jiasheng Jiang discovered that FFmpeg incorrectly handled memory in certain error-handling paths of its TensorFlow DNN backend. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2025-12343)  Quang Luong discovered that FFmpeg incorrectly handled certain subsample data. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-40962)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in FFmpeg. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
